briefings.title: Peter Thiel: The AI Crisis, Europe’s Decline & the Battle for America
briefings.channel: MDMEETS - Essential Talks with Mathias Döpfner
briefings.tldr: Peter Thiel argues that artificial intelligence has broken decades of technological stagnation, but warns that the West—especially Europe—is falling severely behind China and the US, while societal polarization and broken intergenerational compacts threaten democratic stability.

briefings.title: Carlos Basso alerta sobre Peter Thiel, Palantir y el nuevo poder de Silicon Valley
briefings.tldr: The emergence of "Techno-fascism" and the "Dark Enlightenment" ideology, led by figures like Peter Thiel and Palantir Technologies, represents a global shift toward governance by "CEO monarchs" and AI-driven military deterrence, with active expansion efforts now reaching Chile and Argentina.

briefings.title: Meet the New Thiel Fellows
briefings.tldr: The latest Thiel Fellowship class is leveraging AI and custom hardware to disrupt legacy industries—ranging from autonomous logistics and small-cap equity research to government fraud detection—amidst the release of GPT 5.5 and rising national security concerns regarding AI model "distillation" by foreign entities.

briefings.title: The billionaires' utopia blueprint | Throughline
briefings.tldr: Modern tech billionaires are attempting to bypass traditional nation-state governance by creating "startup nations" and private jurisdictions, evolving from historical precedents like Svalbard to modern experiments like Próspera.

briefings.title: What Peter Thiel has to do with Germany’s drones | Berlin Briefing Podcast
briefings.tldr: Germany is fast-tracking a multi-billion euro combat drone deal with startups Helsing and Stark Defense to modernize the Bundeswehr, but the involvement of controversial U.S. investor Peter Thiel in Stark Defense has ignited a fierce political debate over national security, data privacy, and democratic values.

briefings.title: Tariffs, DOGE & Fixing America: Peter Thiel's Skeptic Solutions
briefings.tldr: Peter Thiel argues that extreme optimism and pessimism both lead to inaction, advocating instead for a pragmatic "moderate optimism" that tackles broken, sclerotic institutions by systematically exploiting structural barriers and cultural blind spots.
